# Aiki Individual Contributor License Agreement

Thank you for contributing to Aiki.

This agreement sets out the rights you grant when you contribute. It is adapted from the
Apache Software Foundation's Individual Contributor License Agreement, which is the text
most widely used by open source projects.

**You keep the copyright in everything you write.** You are granting a licence, not giving
your work away. You remain free to use your own contributions however you like, including in
other projects.

To agree, follow the instructions the CLA bot posts on your pull request. If you are
contributing on behalf of an employer who owns your work, see the [CCLA.md](./CCLA.md) instead —
your personal signature alone is not enough in that case.
